summary: Scalar-deleting destructor for an unknown object. Invokes the vtable setter subcall VTableSetterSubCall (0x0046D630) on this (which reinstalls the off_59FC08 vtable as part of teardown), then, when the deleting flag a2 has bit 0 set, releases the object memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF). Returns this unchanged, matching the MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor convention.

local_names.a2: deleting flag: bit 0 controls whether the object allocation is freed

operations.description: Call the vtable setter subcall VTableSetterSubCall (0x0046D630) with this as the __thiscall receiver, reinstalling the object vtable (off_59FC08) during teardown.
Guard on the deleting flag a2: when (a2 & 1) != 0 the object memory is freed.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) with this to release the object allocation when the deleting flag bit 0 is set.
Return this, keeping the object pointer valid as required by the scalar-deleting-destructor convention.
